name: 🍳 Cottage Cheese Scramble
what: Soft scrambled eggs with cottage cheese whisked in, with toast.

core.name: Eggs
core.out: no eggs: this one needs them, see Plan B

core.name: Cottage cheese
core.out: a splash of milk, or cheese on top

extras: baby spinach, butter, chives, shredded cheese

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter.
Whisk 8 eggs, ¾ cup cottage cheese and a pinch of salt.
Butter in a nonstick pan on medium-low. Add spinach if we have it.
Pour in the eggs. Push slowly with a spatula into big soft curds.
Take it off while still a little wet. Toast and serve.

key: Low heat, and pull the pan off early. They finish on the plate.
done: Soft curds, still a little shiny.
plan_b: No eggs? Peanut butter toast or yogurt bowls.
